Name: Fishdew Valley
Author: jokthefoo
Description:
[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list][b][size=5]
What this mod does:[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=2]Adds a 5 new special fish each with a special fishing minigame encounter (including a legendary boss fight)[/size]
[*][size=2]Adds custom fishing minigame for chopping trees (can have treasure chests for extra tree related rewards)[/size]
[*][size=2]Adds custom fishing minigame for watering crops [size=2](can have fairys for extra crop related rewards)[/size][/size]
[*][size=2]Adds custom fishing minigame for mining (when you encounter the new large rock, has slimes to fight and can have geodes or rocks)[/size]
[*][size=2]Adds custom fishing minigame for petting animals (after you have crafted the semi-auto petter, can have treasure chests for animal related rewards)[/size]
[*][size=2]Adds new top tier fishing rod upgraded from the Advanced Iridium Rod (built in treasure find chance)[/size]
[*][size=2]Adds chance to get more than 1 fishing chest (when you get more than 1 they are more valuable)[/size]
[*][size=2]Adds fish swarm chance[/size]
[*][size=2]Adds new pirate tackle (2x the benefit of the treasure hunter tackle)[/size]
[/list][b][size=5]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7Z0fNQ2J/Screenshot-2026-03-20-184834.png[/img]

[/size][size=2]All custom fishing minigames are enable/disabled in the mod config menu if you want some and not the others[/size][size=5]

Artwork
[/size][/b][size=3]Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/suzukiPC]suzukiPC[/url]﻿ for the fishing bars and other artwork![/size][b][size=5]

[/size][/b][size=5][b]Support[/b][/size]
If you encounter any issues with the mod or incompatibilities, please post a detailed message with
your SMAPI log attached. You can do this with the following website: [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url]
